load_model_from_pretrained: load a Qwen3-VL-MoE model from pretrained using transformers AutoProcessor and Qwen3VLMoeForConditionalGeneration
configure_quantization_recipe: configure an FP8 dynamic quantization recipe with QuantizationModifier targeting Linear layers and ignoring lm_head and visual modules
apply_oneshot_quantization: apply one-shot FP8 quantization to a pretrained model using llmcompressor oneshot with a quantization recipe
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and processor to disk in compressed-tensors format using save_pretrained
ignore_quantize_layers: exclude specific layers like lm_head, visual modules, and mlp gate from quantization using regex patterns in QuantizationModifier
